Ergo & areæ ABD, ACE sunt ultimo in duplicata ratione laterum AD, AE. Q.E.D.

translation: Spaces described at the beginning of motion have the duplicate ratio of times. The force wording is edition-specific.
tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" rend="center" xml:id="par27"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Spatia, quæ corpus urgente quacun<ns0:choice><ns0:orig>q;</ns0:orig><ns0:reg>que</ns0:reg></ns0:choice> vi regulari describit, sunt ipso <ns0:lb type="intentional" xml:id="l6" />motus initio in duplicata ratione temporum.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>
latin: Spatia, quæ corpus urgente quacunq; vi regulari describit, sunt ipso motus initio in duplicata ratione temporum.

translation: Represent times by abscissae and generated velocities by ordinates: spaces correspond to the swept areas, invoking Lemma IX.
tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par28">Exponantur tempora per lineas <ns0:hi rend="italic">AD</ns0:hi>, A<ns0:hi rend="italic">E</ns0:hi>, & velocitates genitæ per ordinatas <ns0:hi rend="italic">DB, EC</ns0:hi>, & spatia his velocitatibus descripta erunt ut areæ A<ns0:hi rend="italic">BD</ns0:hi>, A<ns0:hi rend="italic">CE</ns0:hi> his ordinatis descriptæ, hoc est ipso motus initio (per Lemma IX) in duplicata ratione temporum A<ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi>, A<ns0:hi rend="italic">E. Q.E.D.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>
latin: Exponantur tempora per lineas AD, AE, & velocitates genitæ per ordinatas DB, EC, & spatia his velocitatibus descripta erunt ut areæ ABD, ACE his ordinatis descriptæ, hoc est ipso motus initio (per Lemma IX) in duplicata ratione temporum AD, AE. Q.E.D.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par29"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Corol.</ns0:hi> 1. Et hinc facile colligitur, quod corporum similes similium figurarum partes temporibus proportionalibus describentium errores, qui viribus æqualibus in partibus istis ad corpora similiter applicatis generantur, & mensurantur a locis figurarum, ad quæ corpora temporibus ijsdem proportionalibus abs<ns0:choice><ns0:orig>q;</ns0:orig><ns0:reg>que</ns0:reg></ns0:choice> viribus istis pervenirent, sunt ut quadrata temporum in quibus generantur quam proxime.</ns0:p>

Et hinc facile colligitur, quod corporum similes similium figurarum partes temporibus proportionalibus describentium errores, qui viribus æqualibus in partibus istis ad corpora similiter applicatis generantur, & mensurantur a locis figurarum, ad quæ corpora temporibus ijsdem proportionalibus absq; viribus istis pervenirent, sunt ut quadrata temporum in quibus generantur quam proxime.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par30"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Corol.</ns0:hi> 2. Errores autem qui viribus proportionalibus similiter applicatis generantur, sunt ut vires & quadrata temporum conjunctim.</ns0:p>
latin: Corol. 2. Errores autem qui viribus proportionalibus similiter applicatis generantur, sunt ut vires & quadrata temporum conjunctim.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" rend="center" xml:id="par31"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Subtensa evanescens anguli contactus est ultimo in ratione duplicata subtensæ arcus contermini.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>
latin: Subtensa evanescens anguli contactus est ultimo in ratione duplicata subtensæ arcus contermini.

Sit arcus ille AB, tangens ejus A<ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi>, subtensa anguli contactus ad tangentem perpendicularis <ns0:hi rend="italic">BD</ns0:hi>, subtensa arcus AB. Huic subtensæ AB & tangenti AD perpendiculares erigantur A<ns0:hi rend="italic">G</ns0:hi>, BG, concurrentes in G; dein accedant puncta D, B, G, ad puncta <ns0:hi rend="italic">d, b, g</ns0:hi>, sit<ns0:choice><ns0:orig>q;</ns0:orig><ns0:reg>que</ns0:reg></ns0:choice> <ns0:hi rend="italic">I</ns0:hi> intersectio linearum BG, AG ultimo facta ubi puncta D, B accedunt us<ns0:choice><ns0:orig>q;</ns0:orig><ns0:reg>que</ns0:reg></ns0:choice> ad A. Sed quoniam <ns0:hi rend="italic">IG</ns0:hi> assumi potest minor longitudine quavis assignata, fieri potest ut ratio A<ns0:hi rend="italic">G</ns0:hi> ad <ns0:hi rend="italic">Ag</ns0:hi> minus differat a ratione æqualitatis quam pro differentia quavis assignata, adeo<ns0:choice><ns0:orig>q;</ns0:orig><ns0:reg>que</ns0:reg></ns0:choice> ut ratio <ns0:hi rend="italic">AB quad.</ns0:hi> ad <ns0:hi rend="italic">Ab quad.</ns0:hi> minus differat a ratione <ns0:hi rend="italic">BD</ns0:hi> ad <ns0:hi rend="italic">bd</ns0:hi> quam pro differentia quavis assignata. Est ergo, per Lemma I, ratio ultima <ns0:hi rend="italic">AB quad.</ns0:hi> ad <ns0:hi rend="italic">Ab quad.</ns0:hi> æqualis rationi ultimæ B<ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi> ad <ns0:hi rend="italic">bd. Q.E.D.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>

Huic subtensæ AB & tangenti AD perpendiculares erigantur AG, BG, concurrentes in G; dein accedant puncta D, B, G, ad puncta d, b, g, sitq; I intersectio linearum BG, AG ultimo facta ubi puncta D, B accedunt usq; ad A. Manifestum est quod distantia G I minor esse potest quam assignata quævis. Est autem (ex natura circulorum per puncta ABG, Abg transeuntium) AB quad. æquale AG×BD& Abquad. æquale Ag×bd, adeoq; ratio AB quad. ad Ab quad. componitur ex rationibus AG ad Ag & BD ad bd. Triangula rectilinea A<ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi>B, A<ns0:hi rend="italic">db</ns0:hi> sunt ultimo in triplicata ratione laterum A<ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi>, A<ns0:hi rend="italic">d</ns0:hi>, in<ns0:choice><ns0:orig>q;</ns0:orig><ns0:reg>que</ns0:reg></ns0:choice> sesquiplicata laterum <ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi>B, <ns0:hi rend="italic">db</ns0:hi>: Utpote in composita ratione laterum A<ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi> & <ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi>B, A<ns0:hi rend="italic">d</ns0:hi> & <ns0:hi rend="italic">db</ns0:hi> existentia. translation: By the nature of the parabola, the curvilinear area is two thirds of the triangle and the segment one third; these areas are therefore cubic in tangent, chord or arc.

Et quoniam <ns0:hi rend="italic">DB, db</ns0:hi> sunt ultimo parallela & in duplicata ratione ipsarum <ns0:hi rend="italic">AD, Ad</ns0:hi>; erunt areæ ultimæ curvilineæ <ns0:pb xml:id="p34" n="34" /> <ns0:hi rend="italic">ADB, Adb</ns0:hi> (ex natura Parabolæ) duæ tertiæ partes triangulorum rectilineorum <ns0:hi rend="italic">ADB, Adb</ns0:hi>, & segmenta <ns0:hi rend="italic">AB, Ab</ns0:hi> partes tertiæ eorundem triangulorum. Et inde hæ areæ & hæc segmenta erunt in triplicata ratione tum tangentium <ns0:hi rend="italic">AD, Ad</ns0:hi>; tum chordarum & arcuum <ns0:hi rend="italic">AB, Ab</ns0:hi>.</ns0:p>

Et quoniam DB, db sunt ultimo parallela & in duplicata ratione ipsarum AD, Ad; erunt areæ ultimæ curvilineæ ADB, Adb (ex natura Parabolæ) duæ tertiæ partes triangulorum rectilineorum ADB, Adb, & segmenta AB, Ab partes tertiæ eorundem triangulorum. Et inde hæ areæ & hæc segmenta erunt in triplicata ratione tum tangentium AD, Ad; tum chordarum & arcuum AB, Ab.

Sed & inter duos quosvis ex his angulis potest series utrinq; in infinitum pergens angulorum intermediorum inseri, quorum quilibet posterior erit infinite major priore. Ut si inter terminos AD2 &AD3 inseratur series AD136, AD115, AD94, AD73, AD52, AD83, AD114, AD145, AD176, &c. Et rursus inter binos quosvis angulos hujus seriei inseri potest series nova angulorum intermediorum ab invicem infinitis intervallis differentium. Neq; novit natura limitem.

Q.E.D.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par2"><ns0:hi rend="dropCap">Q</ns0:hi><ns0:hi rend="italic">Uantitates, ut & quantitatum rationes, quæ ad æqualitatem tempore quovis finito constanter tendunt, & ante finem temporis illius propius ad invicem accedunt quam pro data quavis differentia, fiunt ultimo æquales.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>
latin: QUantitates, ut & quantitatum rationes, quæ ad æqualitatem tempore quovis finito constanter tendunt, & ante finem temporis illius propius ad invicem accedunt quam pro data quavis differentia, fiunt ultimo æquales.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par3">Si negas; fiant ultimo inequales, & sit earum ultima differentia <ns0:hi rend="italic">D.</ns0:hi> Ergo nequeunt propius ad æqualitatem accedere quam pro data differentia <ns0:hi rend="italic">D</ns0:hi>: contra hypothesin.</ns0:p>
latin: Si negas; fiant ultimo inequales, & sit earum ultima differentia D. Ergo nequeunt propius ad æqualitatem accedere quam pro data differentia D: contra hypothesin.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par4"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Si in Figura quavis</ns0:hi> AacE <ns0:hi rend="italic">rectis</ns0:hi> Aa, AE, <ns0:hi rend="italic">& curva</ns0:hi> AcE <ns0:hi rend="italic">comprehensa, inscribentur parallelogramma quotcunque</ns0:hi> Ab, Bc, Cd, &c. <ns0:hi rend="italic">sub basibus</ns0:hi> AB, BC, CD, &c. <ns0:hi rend="italic">æqualibus, & lateribus</ns0:hi> Bb, Cc, Dd, &c. <ns0:hi rend="italic">Figuræ lateri</ns0:hi> Aa <ns0:hi rend="italic">parallelis <ns0:figure rend="floatRight"><ns0:graphic url="NATP00082-1.png" /><ns0:figDesc /></ns0:figure> comenta; & compleantur parallelogramma</ns0:hi> aKbl, bLcm, cMdn, &c. <ns0:hi rend="italic">Dein horum parallelogrammorum latitudo minuatur, & numerus augeatur in infinitum: dico quod ultimæ rationes, quas habent ad se invicem Figura inscripta</ns0:hi> AKbLcMdD, <ns0:hi rend="italic">circumscripta</ns0:hi> AalbmcndoE, <ns0:hi rend="italic">& curvilinea</ns0:hi> AabcdE, <ns0:hi rend="italic">sunt rationes æqualitatis</ns0:hi>.</ns0:p>
latin: Si in Figura quavis AacE rectis Aa, AE, & curva AcE comprehensa, inscribentur parallelogramma quotcunque Ab, Bc, Cd, &c. sub basibus AB, BC, CD, &c. æqualibus, & lateribus Bb, Cc, Dd, &c. Figuræ lateri Aa parallelis comenta; & compleantur parallelogramma aKbl, bLcm, cMdn, &c. Dein horum parallelogrammorum latitudo minuatur, & numerus augeatur in infinitum: dico quod ultimæ rationes, quas habent ad se invicem Figura inscripta AKbLcMdD, circumscripta AalbmcndoE, & curvilinea AabcdE, sunt rationes æqualitatis.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par5">Nam figuræ inscriptæ & circumscriptæ differentia est summa parallelogrammorum <ns0:hi rend="italic">Kl, Lm, Mn, Do</ns0:hi>, hoc est (ob æquales omnium bases) rectangulum sub unius basi <ns0:hi rend="italic">Kb</ns0:hi> & altitudinum summa <ns0:hi rend="italic">Aa</ns0:hi>, id est rectangulum <ns0:hi rend="italic">ABla</ns0:hi>. Sed hoc rectangulum, eo quod latitudo ejus AB in infinitum minuitur, sit minus quovis dato. Ergo (per Lemma I) Figura inscripta & circumscripta & multo magis Figura curvilinea intermedia fiunt ultimo æquales. <ns0:hi rend="italic">Q.E.D.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>
latin: Nam figuræ inscriptæ & circumscriptæ differentia est summa parallelogrammorum Kl, Lm, Mn, Do, hoc est (ob æquales omnium bases) rectangulum sub unius basi Kb & altitudinum summa Aa, id est rectangulum ABla. Sed hoc rectangulum, eo quod latitudo ejus AB in infinitum minuitur, sit minus quovis dato. Ergo (per Lemma I) Figura inscripta & circumscripta & multo magis Figura curvilinea intermedia fiunt ultimo æquales. Q.E.D.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par6"><ns0:hi rend="italic"> Eædem rationes ultimæ sunt etiam æqualitatis, ubi parallelogramomrum latitudines </ns0:hi>AB, BC, CD &c. <ns0:hi rend="italic">sunt inæquales, & omnes minuuntur in infinitum</ns0:hi>.</ns0:p>
latin: Eædem rationes ultimæ sunt etiam æqualitatis, ubi parallelogramomrum latitudines AB, BC, CD &c. sunt inæquales, & omnes minuuntur in infinitum.

translation: Take AF equal to the greatest width. Its rectangle exceeds the difference of enclosing figures and becomes smaller than any given rectangle as that width diminishes.
tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par7">Sit enim <ns0:hi rend="italic">AF</ns0:hi> æqualis latitudini maximæ, & compleatur parallelogrammum <ns0:hi rend="italic">FAaf</ns0:hi>. Hoc erit majus quam differentia Figuræ inscriptæ & Figuræ circumscriptæ; at latitudine sua <ns0:hi rend="italic">AF</ns0:hi> in infinitum diminuta, minus fiet quam datum quodvis rectangulum. <ns0:hi rend="italic">Q.E.D.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>
latin: Sit enim AF æqualis latitudini maximæ, & compleatur parallelogrammum FAaf. Hoc erit majus quam differentia Figuræ inscriptæ & Figuræ circumscriptæ; at latitudine sua AF in infinitum diminuta, minus fiet quam datum quodvis rectangulum. Q.E.D.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par8"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Corol.</ns0:hi> 1. Hinc summa ultima parallelogrammorum evanescentium coincidit omni ex parte cum Figura curvilinea.</ns0:p>

latin: Corol. 2. Et multo magis Figura rectilinea, quæ chordis evanescentium arcuum ab, bc, cd, &c. comprehenditur, coincidit ultimo cum Figura curvilinea.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par10"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Corol.</ns0:hi> 3. Ut & Figura rectilinea circumscripta quæ tangentibus eorundem arcuum comprehenditur.</ns0:p>
latin: Corol. 3. Ut & Figura rectilinea circumscripta quæ tangentibus eorundem arcuum comprehenditur.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par17">Nam si angulus ille non evanescit, continebit arcus <ns0:hi rend="italic">AB</ns0:hi> cum tangente <ns0:hi rend="italic">AD</ns0:hi> angulum rectilineo æqualem, & propterea curvatura ad ad punctum <ns0:hi rend="italic">A</ns0:hi> non erit continua, contra hypothesin.</ns0:p>
latin: Nam si angulus ille non evanescit, continebit arcus AB cum tangente AD angulum rectilineo æqualem, & propterea curvatura ad ad punctum A non erit continua, contra hypothesin.

translation: With a fixed angle of intersection and ordinate angle, the vanishing areas have the duplicate ratio of corresponding sides. The statement says triangles; the proof treats curvilinear areas.
tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par26"> <ns0:hi rend="italic">Si recta</ns0:hi> AE <ns0:hi rend="italic">& Curva</ns0:hi> ABC <ns0:hi rend="italic">positione datæ se mutuo secent in angulo dato</ns0:hi> A, <ns0:hi rend="italic">& ad rectam illam in alio dato angulo ordinatim applicentur</ns0:hi> BD, CE, <ns0:hi rend="italic">curvæ occurrentes in</ns0:hi> B, C; <ns0:hi rend="italic">dein puncta</ns0:hi> B, C <ns0:hi rend="italic">simul accedant ad punctum</ns0:hi> A: <ns0:hi rend="italic">dico quod areæ triangulorum</ns0:hi> ABD, ACE <ns0:hi rend="italic">erunt ultimo ad invicem in duplicata ratione laterum.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>
latin: Si recta AE & Curva ABC positione datæ se mutuo secent in angulo dato A, & ad rectam illam in alio dato angulo ordinatim applicentur BD, CE, curvæ occurrentes in B, C; dein puncta B, C simul accedant ad punctum A: dico quod areæ triangulorum ABD, ACE erunt ultimo ad invicem in duplicata ratione laterum.

translation: Extend and rescale the ordinates; the tangent and limiting secant coincide, and similar areas have the duplicate side ratio.
tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par27">Etenim dum puncta <ns0:hi rend="italic">B, C</ns0:hi> accedunt <ns0:figure rend="floatRight"><ns0:graphic url="NATP00082-6.png" /><ns0:figDesc /></ns0:figure> ad punctum <ns0:hi rend="italic">A</ns0:hi>, intelligatur semper <ns0:hi rend="italic">AD</ns0:hi> produci ad puncta longiqua <ns0:hi rend="italic">d</ns0:hi> & <ns0:hi rend="italic">e</ns0:hi>, ut sint <ns0:hi rend="italic">Ad, Ae</ns0:hi> ipsis <ns0:hi rend="italic">AD, AE</ns0:hi> proportionales, & erigantur ordinatæ <ns0:hi rend="italic">db, ec</ns0:hi> ordinatis <ns0:hi rend="italic">DB, EC</ns0:hi> parallelæ quæ occurant ipsis <ns0:hi rend="italic">AB, AC</ns0:hi> productis in <ns0:hi rend="italic">b</ns0:hi> & <ns0:hi rend="italic">c</ns0:hi>. latin: Corol. 2. Errores autem qui viribus proportionalibus ad similes Figurarum similium partes similiter applicatis generantur, sunt ut vires & quadrata temporum conjunctim.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par32"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Corol.</ns0:hi> 3. Idem intelligendum est de spatiis quibusvis quæ corpora urgentibus diversis viribus describunt. Hæc sunt, ipso motus initio, ut vires & quadrata temporum conjunctim.</ns0:p>
latin: Corol. 3. Idem intelligendum est de spatiis quibusvis quæ corpora urgentibus diversis viribus describunt. Hæc sunt, ipso motus initio, ut vires & quadrata temporum conjunctim.

translation: Hence forces vary directly as initially described spaces and inversely as squares of times.
tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par33"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Corol.</ns0:hi> 4. Ideoque vires sunt ut spatia, ipso motus initio, descripta directe & quadrata temporum inverse.</ns0:p>
latin: Corol. 4. Ideoque vires sunt ut spatia, ipso motus initio, descripta directe & quadrata temporum inverse.

translation: Squares of times vary directly as described spaces and inversely as forces.
tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="par34"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Corol.</ns0:hi> 5. Et quadrata temporum sunt ut descripta spatia directe & vires inverse.</ns0:p>
latin: Corol. 5. Et quadrata temporum sunt ut descripta spatia directe & vires inverse.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xmlns:ns1="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xml:id="par35">Si quantitates indeterminatæ diversorum generum conferantur inter se, & earum aliqua dicatur esse ut est alia quævis directe vel inverse: sensus est, quod prior augetur vel diminuitur in eadem ratione cum posteriore, vel cum ejus reciproca. Et si earum aliqua dicatur esse ut sunt aliæ duæ vel plures directe vel inverse: sensus est, quod prima augetur vel diminuitur in ratione quæ componitur ex rationibus in quibus aliæ vel aliarum reciprocæ augentur vel diminuuntur. Ut si A dicatur esse ut B directe & C directe & D inverse: sensus est, quod A augetur vel diminuitur in eadem ratione cum <ns0:formula><ns1:math><ns1:mn mathvariant="normal">B</ns1:mn><ns1:mo>×</ns1:mo><ns1:mn mathvariant="normal">C</ns1:mn><ns1:mo>×</ns1:mo> <ns1:mfrac><ns1:mn>1</ns1:mn><ns1:mn mathvariant="normal">D</ns1:mn></ns1:mfrac></ns1:math></ns0:formula>, hoc est, A &  <ns0:formula><ns1:math><ns1:mfrac><ns1:mn mathvariant="normal">BC</ns1:mn><ns1:mn mathvariant="normal">D</ns1:mn></ns1:mfrac></ns1:math></ns0:formula> sunt ad invicem in ratione data.</ns0:p>
latin: Si quantitates indeterminatæ diversorum generum conferantur inter se, & earum aliqua dicatur esse ut est alia quævis directe vel inverse: sensus est, quod prior augetur vel diminuitur in eadem ratione cum posteriore, vel cum ejus reciproca. Et si earum aliqua dicatur esse ut sunt aliæ duæ vel plures directe vel inverse: sensus est, quod prima augetur vel diminuitur in ratione quæ componitur ex rationibus in quibus aliæ vel aliarum reciprocæ augentur vel diminuuntur. Ut si A dicatur esse ut B directe & C directe & D inverse: sensus est, quod A augetur vel diminuitur in eadem ratione cum B×C× 1D, hoc est, A & BCD sunt ad invicem in ratione data.

tei: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" rend="center" xml:id="par36"><ns0:hi rend="italic">Subtensa evanescens anguli contactus, in curvis omnibus curvaturam finitam ad punctum contactus habentibus, est ultimo in ratione duplicata subtensæ arcus contermini.</ns0:hi></ns0:p>

Capi enim potest DB ut AD3: quo in casu Circulus nullus per punctum A inter tangentem AD & curvam AB duci potest, proindeque angulus contactus erit infinite minor Circularibus. Et simili argumento si fiat DB successive ut AD4,AD5,AD6,AD7,&c., habebitur series angulorum contactus pergens in infinitum, quorum quilibet posterior est infinite minor priore. Et si fiat DB successive ut AD2,AD32,AD43,AD54,AD65,AD76,&c. habebitur alia series infinita angulorum contactus, quorum primus est ejusdem generis cum Circularibus, secundus infinite major, & quilibet posterior infinite major priore. Sed & inter duos quosvis ex his angulis potest series utrinque in infinitum pergens angulorum intermediorum inseri, quorum quilibet posterior erit infinite major minorve priore. Ut si inter terminos AD2&AD3 inseratur series AD136,AD115,AD94,AD73,AD52,AD83,AD114,AD145,AD176, &c. Et rursus inter binos quosvis angulos hujus seriei inseri potest series nova angulorum intermediorum ab invicem infinitis intervallis differentium. Neque novit natura limitem.
